title: Auto Loans: amount of a bank-error waiver of a late charge
content:
# Auto Loans: amount of a bank-error waiver of a late charge

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB fixes how much is waived when a late charge on an installment left unpaid by an autopay debit presented to a closed account is corrected as PCB's error, and how the waived amount is applied.

## Clauses

1. **Full amount.** The late charge is waived in full for bank error, as one fee waiver entry that names the late charge; the amount waived is the late charge's full amount, to the cent.
2. **Nothing waived** when the late charge already has a fee waiver naming it, or when it is not PCB's error.
3. **Where the waived amount goes.** Of the waived amount, the part already paid from a payment is applied to principal on the waiver date, and the rest reduces fees due.

## Condition, judgement, outcome

| Late charge already waived once? | PCB's error? | Waived |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | the whole late charge |
| no | no | nothing |
| yes | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (late charge of 18.08)

| Situation | Waived | To principal | Off fees due |
|---|---|---|---|
| PCB's error; late charge unpaid | 18.08 | 0.00 | 18.08 |
| PCB's error; late charge paid by a later payment | 18.08 | 18.08 | 0.00 |
| PCB's error; a waiver already names it | nothing | nothing | nothing |

**Wrong reading:** "waive only the part of the late charge still unpaid." **Correct basis:** the whole late charge is waived; any part already paid goes to principal.
